name: tradrl-evidence
description: Evidence/provenance projection (W028): the auditability spine — pure projections over a world's journal and its imported information artifacts (W027) + dataset descriptors (W020) that yield the EVIDENCE VIEW: per-event source citations (event id → artifact/dataset/record-digest identity), the deterministic content-addressed projection digest chain (same inputs ⇒ same chain, A9), and a typed query surface (lookups by event, by artifact, by dataset — unknown ids are typed errors, never silent). Never mints facts, never invents citations: an event with no declared source carries the honest no-declared-source marker.
